details:
This update for nodejs24 fixes the following issues:

Update to 24.22.3.

- CVE-2026-16728: undici: downstream response desynchronization via retry interceptor (bsc#1273593).
- CVE-2026-16729: undici: setCookie function does not fully sanitize cookie attributes (bsc#1273591).
- CVE-2026-18149: undici: denial of service due to orphaned response body in retry handler (bsc#1279523).
- CVE-2026-18540: undici: HTTP response splitting via retry interceptor (bsc#1279522).
- CVE-2026-19534: undici: denial of service via unrequested WebSocket subprotocol (bsc#1279513).
- CVE-2026-84890: undici: denial of service via unbounded decompression of compressed responses (bsc#1279834).
- CVE-2026-84933: undici: cross-user cookie disclosure via Set-Cookie caching in shared caches (bsc#1279834).
- CVE-2026-84947: undici: response truncation via oversized chunked responses in the dump interceptor (bsc#1279834).
- CVE-2026-84961: undici: TLS certificate validation bypass via dropped connect options in BalancedPool (bsc#1279834).
- CVE-2026-85008: undici: caching and replay of unsafe HTTP method responses (bsc#1279834).
- CVE-2026-85014: undici: denial of service via WebSocketStream unclean close (bsc#1279834).
- CVE-2026-85024: undici: denial of service via unhandled error in WebSocket permessage-deflate decompression
  (bsc#1279834).
- CVE-2026-85152: undici: cross-origin cache poisoning via missing origin isolation in interceptors (bsc#1279834).
- CVE-2026-87018: undici: client process crash when a TLS 1.2 server renegotiates after an established connection and
  presents a different certificate (bsc#1285861).
- CVE-2026-109383: undici: certificate validation bypass via dropped TLS options in Agent (bsc#1285938).
- CVE-2026-109829: undici: cache poisoning and information disclosure via improper cross-origin redirect caching
  (bsc#1285939).
- CVE-2026-109841: undici: subresource integrity bypass via non-lowercase algorithm tokens (bsc#1285940).
- CVE-2026-109869: undici: denial of service via unhandled stream error on excessive content encodings
  (bsc#1285941).
- CVE-2026-109924: undici: denial of service via memory exhaustion in EventSource client (bsc#1285942).
- CVE-2026-109932: undici: denial of service via unbounded WebSocket PONG buffering (bsc#1285943).
- CVE-2026-116592: undici: cache poisoning and cross-user disclosure via intermediate redirect hops (bsc#1290357).
- CVE-2026-116630: undici: cross-user information disclosure via cross-origin redirect revalidation (bsc#1290342).
- CVE-2026-120222: undici: denial of service via unhandled exception in cache-interceptor response replay (bsc#1290286).
- CVE-2026-120415: undici: cross-origin credential disclosure via array-of-tuples headers bypassing redirect stripping
  (bsc#1290319).
- CVE-2026-120423: undici: subresource integrity bypass via whitespace in integrity metadata (bsc#1290325).
- CVE-2026-120474: undici: cross-user cache disclosure via same-origin redirect (bsc#1290366).
- CVE-2026-123828: denial of service via HTTP/2 Alt-Svc heap buffer overflow (bsc#1290144).
- CVE-2026-123829: information disclosure via improper permission checks in recursive file watching (bsc#1290145).
- CVE-2026-123862: denial of service via abrupt disconnection during zlib compression (bsc#1290146).
- CVE-2026-123863: denial of service via improper HTTP/2 session teardown (bsc#1290147).
- CVE-2026-123864: information disclosure via HTTPS parser re-entrancy (bsc#1290148).
- CVE-2026-123865: denial of service via HTTP/2 session resource leak during shutdown (bsc#1290149).
- CVE-2026-123866: information disclosure via use-after-free during HTTP/2 stream teardown (bsc#1290150).
- CVE-2026-123867: mutual TLS authorization bypass via incomplete SNI context configuration (bsc#1290151).
- CVE-2026-123868: denial of service via HTTP/2 memory exhaustion (bsc#1290152).
- CVE-2026-123871: information disclosure via invalid proxy configuration error messages (bsc#1290153).
- CVE-2026-123872: client certificate authentication bypass via TLS renegotiation (bsc#1290154).
- CVE-2026-123873: improper checks for heap snapshot destination path when using the '--permission' flag (bsc#1290434).
- CVE-2026-123874: denial of service via HTTP/2 use-after-free (bsc#1290155).
- CVE-2026-123875: denial of service via cancelled HTTP/2 file downloads (bsc#1290156).
- CVE-2026-123877: certificate validation bypass via TLS session cache reuse (bsc#1290157).
- CVE-2026-126051: denial of service via premature socket closure during TLS handshake (bsc#1290143).
